specification: For arbitrary state, patch and error types and an arbitrary closure: a ghost trace shows Ok is the in-order composition of exactly one successful application per patch starting from the detached value, and Err is the error of the first failing application after a successful prefix.

Proptest.includes: patch application unwinding through the real kernel; the real Scene against an independent tree model

harness: memory boundaries with three unwinding positions
Miri.note: no leak of detached values; the generated model test is ignored under Miri

cargo-fuzz.note: no-panic path only; the two counts are read_boundary and batch_decode, and only read_boundary reaches this kernel

Kani.note: start value, up to four patches and the length symbolic; Kani has no unwinding model

Loom.reason: The kernel holds no shared state and no synchronization primitive; Scene::apply_batch_at owns the scene through &mut self, so the compiler excludes concurrent access.
Loom.substitute_evidence: None added: the compiler's exclusive-borrow rule is the argument. It is not a concurrency proof.

real_scene_test.covers: Real Scene::apply_batch_at through the public API against an independent tree model: stale batches, empty batches, first-failure errors, whole-tree comparison after each batch, unchanged scene and version on failure, one version step on success, and a later patch observing an earlier one in the same batch.
real_scene_test.mutation_checked: Four manual mutations each made it fail (one run each, not in the Verus control table): applying patches in place on the active scene, not advancing the version, stopping after the first patch, reversing patch order.
